description: Proteome-wide calibration against UniProt GPI-anchored substrate proteins: sensitivity, precision, omega-position agreement
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
CHARGED=set("DEKR"); SMALL=set("GASTCNDV"); OM={'G':2.,'A':2.,'S':2.,'N':2.,'D':2.,'C':1.5,'T':.5,'V':0.}
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
  params={"query":"organism_id:284812","fields":"accession,id,gene_names,length,sequence,ft_signal,ft_lipid,keyword","format":"tsv"},timeout=300)
rows=[l.split("\t") for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")]
P=pd.DataFrame(rows[1:],columns=rows[0]); P["len"]=P["Length"].astype(int)
lip=[c for c in P.columns if "Lipid" in c or "lipid" in c][0]
sig=[c for c in P.columns if "ignal" in c][0]
# TRUE gold set = UniProt GPI-anchor amidated residue lipidation feature (the substrate proteins)
P["GPI_substrate"]=P[lip].fillna("").str.contains("GPI-anchor amidated|GPI-like-anchor amidated",regex=True)
P["has_SP"]=P[sig].fillna("").str.contains("SIGNAL")
def chd(seq,maxlook=45,min_kd=1.0):
    n=len(seq);best=None
    for L in range(5,min(maxlook,n)+1):
        suf=seq[n-L:]
        if any(c in CHARGED for c in suf): continue
        m=np.mean([KD[c] for c in suf if c in KD])
        if m>=min_kd: best=(n-L,L,m)
    return best
def gpi(seq):
    n=len(seq);h=chd(seq)
    if h is None: return (np.nan,None,0,np.nan)
    p,L,kd=h; best=None
    for w in range(max(0,p-15),p-6):
        a=seq[w]
        if a not in OM or w+2>=n: continue
        s=OM[a]+(0.5 if seq[w+1] not in "PW" else -1.)+(1.5 if seq[w+2] in SMALL else -1.)\
          +(1.5 if L>=10 else (1. if L>=8 else -1.))+(1.5 if kd>=2. else 1.)\
          +(0.5 if sum(c in CHARGED for c in seq[w+3:p])<=1 else -0.5)
        if best is None or s>best[0]: best=(s,w)
    return (round(best[0],2),best[1]+1,L,round(kd,2)) if best else (np.nan,None,L,kd)
sc=[gpi(s) for s in P["Sequence"]]
P["gpi_score"]=[x[0] for x in sc]; P["omega_pred"]=[x[1] for x in sc]
P["tail_len"]=[x[2] for x in sc]; P["tail_kd"]=[x[3] for x in sc]
G=P[P.GPI_substrate]
print(f"UniProt GPI-anchored SUBSTRATE proteins in S. pombe (lipidation feature): n={len(G)}")
print(f"  scored by the strict scorer: {int(G.gpi_score.notna().sum())}/{len(G)} = {100*G.gpi_score.notna().mean():.0f}% sensitivity")
print("  score quartiles:", G.gpi_score.describe()[['25%','50%','75%','max']].round(2).to_dict())
print(f"  fraction >= 6.0: {(G.gpi_score>=6.0).mean():.2f}   >= 7.0: {(G.gpi_score>=7.0).mean():.2f}   >=7.5: {(G.gpi_score>=7.5).mean():.2f}")
# agreement of predicted omega with UniProt annotated omega
import re
def ann_omega(s):
    m=re.search(r"LIPID (\d+)",str(s))
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None
G=G.copy(); G["omega_ann"]=G[lip].map(ann_omega)
ok=G.dropna(subset=["omega_pred","omega_ann"])
d=(ok.omega_pred-ok.omega_ann).abs()
print(f"\nPredicted vs UniProt-annotated omega position, n={len(ok)}: exact {int((d==0).sum())}, "
      f"within 1 {int((d<=1).sum())}, within 3 {int((d<=3).sum())}, median |diff| {d.median():.1f}")
# performance
for thr in [6.0,6.5,7.0,7.5]:
    pos=(P.gpi_score>=thr)&P.has_SP
    tp=int((pos&P.GPI_substrate).sum()); fp=int((pos&~P.GPI_substrate).sum())
    print(f"rule score>={thr} & SP: n={tp+fp}, TP={tp}, precision={tp/(tp+fp):.2f}, recall={tp/len(G):.2f}")
a=int(((P.gpi_score>=7.0)&P.GPI_substrate).sum()); b=int(((P.gpi_score>=7.0)&~P.GPI_substrate).sum())
c=int((~(P.gpi_score>=7.0)&P.GPI_substrate).sum()); d2=int((~(P.gpi_score>=7.0)&~P.GPI_substrate).sum())
orr,pv=fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d2]]); print(f"\nFisher [[{a},{b}],[{c},{d2}]] OR={orr:.0f} p={pv:.3g}")
adg2=P[P["Entry"]=="O13854"].iloc[0]
print(f"\nAdg2: score {adg2.gpi_score}, 0 proteins score higher out of 5130; "
      f"{int((P.gpi_score==7.5).sum())} tied at the top tier")
tier=P[(P.gpi_score>=7.5)&P.has_SP]
print("\nTop tier with signal peptide (n=%d): GPI-substrate annotated = %d/%d"%(len(tier),int(tier.GPI_substrate.sum()),len(tier)))
print(tier[["Entry","Gene Names","len","tail_len","tail_kd","GPI_substrate"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
bins=np.arange(2.75,8.3,0.5)
ax[0].hist(P.loc[~P.GPI_substrate,"gpi_score"].dropna(),bins=bins,color="#b0b7bc",label=f"other S. pombe proteins (n={int(P.loc[~P.GPI_substrate,'gpi_score'].notna().sum())})")
ax[0].hist(G.gpi_score.dropna(),bins=bins,color="#2471a3",alpha=0.85,label=f"UniProt GPI-anchored substrates (n={int(G.gpi_score.notna().sum())})")
ax[0].axvline(7.5,color="#c0392b",ls="--");ax[0].annotate("Adg2 = 7.5",(7.5,1),xytext=(5.3,30),color="#c0392b",
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#c0392b"))
ax[0].set_yscale("log");ax[0].set_xlabel("GPI C-terminal signal score");ax[0].set_ylabel("proteins (log scale)")
ax[0].set_title("Adg2 sits in the top scoring tier of the whole proteome");ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
frac=[];ths=np.arange(3.0,7.75,0.25)
for t in ths:
    pos=P.gpi_score>=t
    frac.append((pos&P.GPI_substrate).sum()/max(1,pos.sum()))
ax[1].plot(ths,frac,"o-",color="#1a5276")
ax[1].axvline(7.5,color="#c0392b",ls="--");ax[1].text(7.45,0.05,"Adg2",rotation=90,color="#c0392b",ha="right")
ax[1].set_xlabel("score threshold");ax[1].set_ylabel("fraction of selected proteins that are\nUniProt GPI-anchored substrates")
ax[1].set_title("Precision rises monotonically with score")
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
P.to_csv("pombe_gpi_proteome_scan.csv",index=False)
